<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_EmployeeDevelopment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeeDevelopment" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ProcessBegins" name="Process begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePlan" name="Manager and HR create personal development plan">
      <bpmn:documentation>The plan may include training programs, mentorship, or additional responsibilities.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit" name="Continue development and receive feedback"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Employee enhances skills"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FeedbackEvaluation" name="Supervisors provide feedback and evaluate performance"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentJoin" name="Development activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReachMilestones" name="Reach development milestones"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HRReview" name="HR conducts formal performance review"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Promotion approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitions to new role"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Promotion not approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Identify" sourceRef="StartEvent_ProcessBegins" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_Plan" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreatePlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Plan_Split" sourceRef="Task_CreatePlan" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Enhance" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentSplit" targetRef="Task_FeedbackEvaluation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enhance_Join" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Join" sourceRef="Task_FeedbackEvaluation" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Milestones" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ReachMilestones"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestones_Consider" sourceRef="Task_ReachMilestones" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Consider_Review" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion" targetRef="Task_HRReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Approval" sourceRef="Task_HRReview" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finalize_End" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-development">

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_EmployeeDevelopment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ManagerHR" name="Manager and HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Development</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyNeeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreatePlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConcurrentActivities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConsiderPromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalizePromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Promoted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnhanceSkills</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReachMilestones</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisors" name="Supervisors">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FeedbackEvaluation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HRReview" name="Conduct a formal performance review"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Promotion approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Plan_Concurrent" sourceRef="Task_CreatePlan" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentActivities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Concurrent_Enhance" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentActivities" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Concurrent_Feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentActivities" targetRef="Task_FeedbackEvaluation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enhance_Milestones" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Task_ReachMilestones"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_FeedbackEvaluation" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackBranch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestones_Consider" sourceRef="Task_ReachMilestones" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Consider_Review" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion" targetRef="Task_HRReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Approval" sourceRef="Task_HRReview" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
